backend.renderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M4 Pro, Unspecified Version)

renderer: WebGL2 GroundGlassRTT; offline image registration uses deterministic bilinear resampling

measurementProtocol.rawAndProcessedCameraState: must match field-for-field for focal length, focus, aperture, Rise, Shift, Tilt, Swing; scene, render quality, internal/display dimensions and sampled film dimensions must match
measurementProtocol.sourceResolution: Processed intermediate capture is 960x720; Raw canvas screenshot is normalized to the 480x360 CSS display grid
measurementProtocol.outputGrid: Use each record's canvasCssWidthPx × canvasCssHeightPx; bilinearly resize both captures to that display grid before ROI extraction
measurementProtocol.edgeMetric: per-row RGB8 luma 10–90% transition; median across valid rows
measurementProtocol.uncertainty: 95% percentile bootstrap interval of row medians, 2000 deterministic replicates; phase sensitivity is the measured width envelope after eight fixed horizontal subpixel resampling offsets

predeclaredDecisionTolerance.rationale: A quarter of one display pixel is the reporting floor for a display-referred edge difference, not an optical or CoC tolerance.

measurementProtocol.physicalCoC: Report canonical feature CoC/radii and renderer stage readback separately. Readback encoding is recorded; point-to-texel world-position mismatch is not treated as a quantization-only error bound.

proposalSupport.limitation: A support gap is not proof that this was the source of the manually observed room-image oscillation.

limitations: These captures use the diagnostic optical fixture, not the original room materials.
Raw and Processed are separate capture runs, not simultaneous render-target snapshots.
The image comparison is display-referred and does not calibrate the shader's physical CoC-to-PSF transfer.
Row bootstrap uncertainty is conditional on captured rows and does not cover scene, browser, GPU, or repeated-capture variance.
An insufficient pixel-phase distribution is reported as inconclusive rather than as a pass or failure.
The WebGPU CPU aperture reference is not used as an exact oracle for the WebGL shader.
